mcp-ext.server.enabled.description: Start the HTTP server when StarUML starts. Takes effect after a restart.

mcp-ext.server.port.description: Loopback port the HTTP server listens on. Takes effect after a restart.

mcp-ext.server.logLevel.description: What the extension writes to the developer console (Debug > Show DevTools): errors, plus startup, plus one line per request.

mcp-ext.token.description: When set, every request needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Tools > MCP Extension > Generate Access Token creates one. Applies to the next request.

mcp-ext.security.allowedOrigins.description: Requests from web pages carry an Origin header and are refused unless the origin is listed here, comma-separated, e.g. 'http://localhost:3000'.

mcp-ext.limits.maxBodyKiB.description: Largest request body accepted, in KiB; larger requests get 413. Applies to the next request.

mcp-ext.limits.maxBatchOps.description: Most ops one /batch request may carry; more get 413. Applies to the next request.

mcp-ext.limits.timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a request that is still waiting (exports, commands) is answered 504; the work itself is not cancelled.

mcp-ext.limits.commandsPerMinute.description: Most /execute_command calls in any minute, from all clients together; more get 429.
